Runtime evidence is recorded separately.

ios-swiftui-runtime.summary: 0.1.3 UI tests passed: tab lifecycle and first tap, tab artwork and tints, drag lens, visual tiers, icon buttons and programmatic menus, toolbar dismissal (no opaque frames), context menu, badges/segments/FAB, search/toast/scroll edge, expanding pills, SwiftUI cluster merging and RTL, adaptive accessibility, slider. The GitHub device-test run on the final candidate passed. Captures inspected. After the expanding-pill shadow fix, the pill test passed again on 26.5 and the shadow was inspected.

ios-fallback-runtime.summary: Blur-tier and pre-26 checks passed: tab artwork and tints, visual tiers (blur and standard, light and dark), tab lifecycle and navigation, expanding pills, badges, context menu and plain fallback, toolbar and menus. iOS 15-17 remains unexecuted. Pills and badges passed again on 18.6 after the shadow fix.
